title: Combine two separately generated Seedance 2.0 videos in edit...
content: Combine two separately generated Seedance 2.0 videos in editing to create a longer-form film sequence.
description:
A Seedance 2.0 video I created with @YouArtStudio 

The Seedance 2.0 model is truly groundbreaking. I had the chance to test it, and the scenes are incredibly smooth and cinematic. They’ve made serious progress in longer-form films and character consistency. I made two videos and combined them, and I think the result turned out really nice. What do you think? I’d love to hear your comments.
